messages:
sofia_release: Heads-up — prepping a mid-window micro-cutover in ~10m. Plan: quiesce writes for 30s, drain console caches, pin runtime+router to v2.4.3-canary at 5% for 10m, then ramp to 20% if metrics look good. Will update release notes. Any objections?

mike_runtime: Quick Q — do we want to enable the KV eviction guard like last time? saw latency spike during the drain when shards rebalanced.

sofia_release: Good call. Yes enable eviction-guard=on for router pods during drain. That should avoid churn.

emma_console: I'll freeze dashboard alerts for noise and add a "canary running" banner in the Console UI so support knows it's intentional. Updating release notes now.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Preflight OK. Resources: runtime v2.4.3-canary image available; router variant built. Action requested by @sofia_release. Phase=PREP. Use `/deploy start 8421350000` to kick off.

mike_runtime: Starting quiesce step now — stopping ingestion workers gracefully. Running:```bash
kubectl -n runtime rollout pause deployment/runtime-ingest
kubectl annotate pods --selector=app=runtime evict-guard=true
```

dave_sre: I'll be watching infra. If p50 > 300ms or errors >1% for >2m, we cut traffic. Also alert on node evictions.

frank_api: API contract confirmed backward compatible, no schema flip. We can proceed with header-split after canary if steady.

sofia_release: Canary rollout plan: deploy-bot to route 5% traffic to canary for 10m, then automated checks (error rate, p50/p95, console error spikes). Rollback pin: v2.4.2-stable. Rollback triggers: error_rate > 1% sustained 2m, p95 > 800ms, or eviction events. Acknowledge?

mike_runtime: :thumbsup: quiesce complete, draining KV caches now. Starting deploy-bot run: `/deploy start 8421350000 --canary 5% --pin runtime,router=v2.4.3-canary`

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary started — routing 5% to runtime:v2.4.3-canary and router:v2.4.3-canary. Monitoring hooks attached. Link: https://deploys.redwood.internal/8421350000

dave_sre: Seeing small CPU uptick on router-canary nodes but within threshold. No evictions. Latency stable. Holding.

emma_console: Release notes pushed and changelog link posted to #product-release. Banner up in Console: "Canary: v2.4.3-canary (5% traffic)"

frank_api: Confirming header-split toggle ready but will wait for 20% ramp.

sofia_release: If anyone sees an issue call it out now. If we stay green for 10m we'll ramp to 20%. If we need to rollback, Mike will trigger `/deploy rollback 8421350000 --pin runtime,router=v2.4.2-stable` and SRE will cut traffic.

mike_runtime: Copy. Keeping logs and tracing enabled. I'll run the rollback command on SRE signal.

dave_sre: All good for now. Will escalate if error windows appear.

sofia_release: Proceeding to hold for the 10m canary. Will post again before ramp.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Status update — canary @5% healthy at +5m. No alerts triggered.
